title: FlyLo UI regression lessons that belong in the platform
summary: The passenger-list failures are architecture evidence, not isolated browser bugs. Preserve the lessons so future FlyLo and Federation-company UIs consume stable shared list/row semantics.
lessons: A blank sales passenger panel was caused by treating passengers (an Array) as the numeric row count. Keep passengerCount and passengers separate.
Manage Booking must bind actions to immutable PAX identities rather than visible row position.
A booking lookup miss is a domain outcome and must not be raised as an ooRexx runtime/syntax condition or leak source positions to passengers.
Passenger/booking state must survive ./flylo restart; renderer correctness cannot compensate for a non-durable airline runtime.
If a required collection is missing or invalid, fail closed and do not expose Continue/Submit.
Do not create another FlyLo-local row/list framework when the shared Wire UI stack owns this problem.

provenance.claim: Passenger collection/count ambiguity and fail-closed passenger-step repair.
Manage-booking domain-result boundary, stable passenger identity and server-authoritative servicing context.
